name: designforge-monorepo
description: DesignForge: Production-grade design platform with Canva capabilities and first-class AI-agent MCP control layer

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@designforge/core && npm run build --workspace=@designforge/ai-adapter && npm run build --workspace=@designforge/mcp-server && npm run build --workspace=@designforge/browser-agent
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=designforge-web
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:ai && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:agent && npm run test:e2e
